title: AquaContam: An ML Benchmark for Predicting PFAS and Heavy Metal Contamination in U.S. Drinking Water
description: Integrated water quality dataset and benchmark suite for predicting PFAS and heavy metal contamination across U.S. public water systems. Includes fifteen data sources (thirteen contributing), 7 benchmark tasks, 20 model families (29 classes), geospatial features, and environmental justice analysis. The compiled data are released under CC BY 4.0; the accompanying code is Apache-2.0-licensed in the source repository. The Minnesota MDH records are excluded from this archive pending the agency's redistribution confirmation; the archive documents the request route by which the same export can be requested from the agency and verified against the pinned checksum. AquaContam is a research benchmark, not a regulatory or operational risk-assessment product.
